gloss: on the road, on the street

definitions.gloss: on the road, on the street, roadside
definitions.explanation: The surface of a road or street, or the area immediately on or beside it. Often used as a location modifier.

examples.japanese: {路上|ろじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: To park a car on the street.

examples.japanese: {路上|ろじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking on the street is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {路上|ろじょう}⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}っている→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧がいた。
examples.english: There were young people singing at a street performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{路上|ろじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: On rainy days, the road surface is slippery, so please be careful.

notes:
{路上|ろじょう} refers to the surface of a road or the area on a street. It is commonly used as a modifier.

COMPOUNDS:
- {路上|ろじょう}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧ (street parking)
- {路上|ろじょう}⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧ (street performance)
- {路上|ろじょう}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ (smoking on the street)
- {路上|ろじょう}{生活者|せいかつしゃ} (homeless person, lit. person living on the street)

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on the street) or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (onto the street)
- Frequently appears in rules and regulations about public behavior
